decision: Do not mutate registry from this design. Factory projection is 84 clean admits, below the current >=150 mass-expansion preference; use this only if no higher-yield handle is available or after source handles improve.
implementation_next_steps: Add fingerprint and ontology node only with tests that preserve source-wall leakage closure.
Implement a reviewed UniProt source runner using SDR family/domain, NAD(P), active-site, and Rhea participant evidence as admission context.
Refresh 42fp OOS hard-negative preregistration, preview bounded windows, aggregate only completed windows, run row guardrail audit, and apply only if mechanism-first gates pass.
